subject.title: Feature request: session:reset hook event for memory persistence on auto-resets

question: Which automatic reset hook contract should OpenClaw support for daily and idle rollover memory persistence?
rationale: The missing persistence path is source-proven, but the permanent API shape affects internal hooks, typed plugin hooks, privacy expectations, and upgrade-visible session behavior.

options.title: Refine the active reset PR
options.body: Use the active PR as the narrow implementation path, then require a clean refresh, real rollover proof, docs alignment, and explicit acceptance of the widened hook behavior.

options.title: Define a typed session reset event
options.body: Pause the active PR and design a session:reset or session:before-reset lifecycle surface before wiring bundled session-memory to it.

options.title: Use lifecycle hooks only
options.body: Keep automatic rollover on typed session_end/before_reset-style lifecycle hooks and adapt memory persistence around that contract instead of adding command-style actions.

recommendation.title: Refine the active reset PR
recommendation.body: Use the active PR as the narrow implementation path, then require a clean refresh, real rollover proof, docs alignment, and explicit acceptance of the widened hook behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc is connected to the active candidate repair and recent session-memory work, making them the best available routing owner for the hook contract choice.
